Let me analyze this ticket.

Alexander Brown (E018) requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Analyst, full_time, recommends write for Payroll
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommends read for Payroll

The Security note says the security record governs: contractor, basic training. Contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. So max is read.

Requested: admin. Max is read. Grant the maximum (read). Never grant more than requested.

So decision: read.

The conflicting facts: HR said full-time, security said contractor. The security note says security record governs. Given the policy, for contractor with basic training max is read. If full-time Analyst, max would be write (admin requires owning role - Payroll Specialist). Either way, admin is not allowed. So the max is at most write; the employee gets read per security record.

I'll submit decision: read, with reasoning.
